inventory.label: the heron feather
inventory.notes: Acknowledged today by the lead heron of the season's first northbound flight: one bank, one look, no request. The feather's meaning closes nine days after it began. It is still on YY's back; it is no longer a question.

inventory.label: Mira's reading-seat (informal)
inventory.notes: After today's reading of the heron flight, Mira opened a new column in her ledger headed *morning readings — YY*. The seat at the bend on the flat rock is now standing-room for him by an arrangement that has not been spoken aloud and does not need to be.

inventory.label: three hickory kernels (week 1 of the morning-readings rate)
inventory.notes: Half the handful Mira offered today; YY left the other half with her by negotiation, to set a fair weekly rate rather than a generous one. All three are on the back shelf of the treehouse pantry.

identity_notes: Late winter — YY has the syrup-drop's emptiness on the kitchen ledge (delivered to Mira) and a new column with his name on it.
Yesterday: delivered the reading aloud; the lead crow nodded; Mira wrote *delivered.*

Today: heard the new first-call as eight herons crossing the ridge in a vee at first light. The lead heron banked once over the dead pine and looked down; the look found YY (and the feather along his back). Brought the syrup-drop to Mira; she opened a *morning readings — YY* column and gave him a small handful of last fall's hickory kernels.
Standing thread: the feather's nine-day arc closes. The role's nine-day arc opens.
